neighbours.label: Nervous-system anatomy and neurological disease words (brain, nerve, neuro-, spinal cord, encephal-, paraly-), in the medical sense; not other organs and not 'nervous' meaning anxious
neighbours.notes: Probes: matched other-organ twins scored <0.03 (encephalitis 0.88 vs hepatitis 0.01); 'nervous' as anxious 0.01, 'brainstorm' 0.02. Known leak: ' stroke' fires even in 'a stroke of luck' (0.33), so stroke is kept out of this test. Feeds the L9 nerve neuron (zero-ablation drop 0.15).
